title: Race Results rebuilt from the disc's own RaceOver menu
summary: The single-player Race Results page now follows Overlays.pb [RaceOver Menu]: the same near-black rounded panel, faint title strip and black navigation pill as Pause. It lists places 1.-5. with names, then four centred columns (Total Time, Best Lap, Stunt Score, Profile Points) with two-line labels and faint rules. Continue, Replay and Hide Menu sit in the pill; Hide shows only Unhide Menu. Continue opens a Quit? page (Restart, Quit Event). Championship rounds are titled Championship Race Results. The ghost medal reveal stays inside the page. Port additions: a summary line, the player row in gold, and Replay. PR #704, closes #698, part of #679.
details: Verification: results unit tests 8/8; test_engine_race_replay, test_engine_ghost_challenges and test_engine_championship pass; desktop and portrait screenshots inspected.
limitation: The course map is hidden while the page is up; no PlayStation button icons. Known bugs: #702 (best laps on 1-lap races) and #703 (Escape also opens Pause).
